records.system_name_en: Korea Racing Authority weekly timetable system
records.revalidation_trigger: Revalidate if the KRA weekly route charset, venue-column layout, meeting-date mapping, or Race 1-N post-time coverage changes.
limitations: Public output is capped at Rank A and includes only meeting identity plus Race 1-N labels and post times.

Race names, distances, surfaces, course labels, participant data, betting data, results, payouts, predictions, raw-source content, embedded video, and direct streams are excluded from this reviewed publication unit.
Automatic approval, automatic merge, deployment, and unattended publication remain disabled.
records.notes: Live proof run 33517131024 / artifact 9804098883 reproduced six current KRA meetings across Seoul, Busan-Gyeongnam, and Jeju with complete post-time sequences after the EUC-KR decoding and Jeju raw-column fixes. Collector observations above Rank A are bounded to the reviewed public ceiling A.
